modules.title: Agent rules
modules.description: Shared rules in AGENTS.md, the pointer files every agent reads (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity), and the rule docs for packages, Unity/MCP pitfalls and keeping these tools in the package.

modules.title: Virtual commits
modules.description: Agents never commit: they register a virtual commit (tools/git/agent-commit.ps1) and you commit and push the records you pick with virtual-commit.bat. Includes the worktree guard hook and the index repair script.

modules.title: Agent play testing
modules.description: tools/agentplay/agentplay.py: one shared standalone build (script-only changes patched in seconds), one player per agent, driven by commands; the editor Play Mode claim; the testing policy and test deadlines. The player side is this package's AgentPlay harness and AgentPlayBuild.

modules.title: Unity MCP setup
modules.description: Registers the MCP for Unity server (http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp) for Claude Code (.mcp.json) and Codex (.codex/config.toml). The fast_play tool and MCP auto-start compile in when com.coplaydev.unity-mcp is installed.

modules.title: Agent skills
modules.description: Gameplay, environment and asset skills (unity-gameplay-workflow, environment-design, concept-art-to-3d, model-to-textured-asset, game-prop-concept-art) for Claude Code, Codex, Kilo and Antigravity.

modules.title: Production planner skill
modules.description: The do-task skill: an agent takes one card from the production plan (the project-manager board and its pm command), marks it started, does and verifies the work, and ticks it off once you confirm. For projects that use the planner.

modules.title: Procedural animation rule
modules.description: Motion computed in code always gets an editable curve profile (ScriptableObject) instead of hard-coded easing.

modules.title: Agent Task Board
modules.description: A local kanban shared with your agents (tools/taskboard, task-board.bat): agents claim tasks, post progress and send finished work to Review; committing the virtual commit moves it to Done.
